concept_transformation_rule: tenure > 29.0 -> invert Churn (No <-> Yes); else preserve Churn

development_evaluation_policy.dev_train_pool: nested_adapt_budgets B50 (N=50), B100 (N=100), B200 (N=200) carved from D_target_adapt_pool
development_evaluation_policy.dev_validation_partition: clean residual adaptation pool records (N=292, derived by filtering out customer '2676-ISHSF' which duplicates '9122-UMROB' in B200), verified exactly 0 duplicate-group overlap with B200
development_evaluation_policy.locked_target_evaluation_partition: D_target_eval (N=493), held strictly isolated during development, evaluated once as locked comparative benchmark
strictly_forbidden_practices: Tuning synthetic quantity K on D_target_eval
Selecting authentic weights or oversampling ratios on D_target_eval
Filtering or selecting generator checkpoints using D_target_eval
Iterative retraining based on D_target_eval feedback

B0_frozen_source.description: Frozen unadapted source model trained exclusively on D_source_train

B1_naive_pooling.description: Standard unweighted pooling of source training data and labeled adaptation budget

B2_target_ros.description: Random OverSampling (ROS) of authentic target adaptation records to add K duplicate records
B2_target_ros.research_role: Isolate row volume and duplication effects from true synthetic generative diversity

B3_balanced_domain_weighting.description: Sample-weighted adaptation assigning target records a weight inversely proportional to partition representation
B3_balanced_domain_weighting.target_weight_formula: w_target = N_source / B_k (e.g. 69.04 for B50, 34.52 for B100, 17.26 for B200); w_source = 1.0
B3_balanced_domain_weighting.research_role: Test whether cost-sensitive weighting counters historical pre-drift dominance without data generation

B4_target_only.description: Train classifier strictly on the labeled adaptation records B_k, discarding all pre-drift source data
B4_target_only.research_role: Benchmark performance when conflicting historical source data is completely eliminated

B5_prespecified_weighting.description: Source + target training with a fixed grid of prespecified target weights
B5_prespecified_weighting.research_role: Evaluate fixed heuristic sample weighting without empirical tuning leakage

S1_raw_synthetic.description: Source train + authentic target (B_k) + raw synthetic records (K)

S2_screened_synthetic.description: Source train + authentic target (B_k) + quality-screened synthetic records (K)
S2_screened_synthetic.validation_filtering: Tier 1 structural + Tier 2 hard bounds + Tier 3 empirical billing plausibility

S3_slice_targeted.description: Source train + authentic target (B_k) + screened synthetic records conditioned on diagnosed drift slice

S4_target_only_synthetic.description: Authentic target (B_k) + screened synthetic records (K), discarding pre-drift source records
S4_target_only_synthetic.research_role: Evaluate synthetic data expansion when historical source records are abandoned

TVAE.distribution_mode: Joint P(X, Y) with discrete columns specified

TabDDPM.cpu_feasibility: COMPUTATIONALLY_HEAVY (Must be restricted to K=50 pilot on B200)

minimum_effective_repair_criteria.delta_f1_target_dev_val: > 0.0 over strongest authentic control (max(B1, B2, B3, B4, B5))

stopping_conditions.generator_mode_collapse: Duplicate row rate in synthetic samples > 90%
stopping_conditions.partition_leakage: Any cross-partition index or duplicate-group overlap detected
stopping_conditions.invalid_label_provenance: Any unverified feature mutation labeled as ground truth
